interpretation: AI decision file exists and was read, but a cited evidence field was not in prior fixed exact-path allowlist; no semantic inference from the error.
root_cause_in_code: Validator accepted only entire context_examples/story_metadata_excerpt/w17_context hints, not indexed nested paths into actual frozen kit.
new_policy: Support canonical dot/array-index path and bracketed JSONPath keys for allowed, existing kit subtrees.
Resolve every cited pointer against SHA256-pinned private evidence kit with actual array index bounds.
Reject cross-pair old-world references, invalid fields, non-existent array indices, duplicate canonical paths.
Require meaningful evidence from both specific old source and W17 for WORLD_LINK or CLEAR_WITH_EVIDENCE.
Return only pointer ordinal and source rank for failures; do not expose raw citation values or private story text.
